data.description: ## Description **What**: Establish the structured-request contract (`docs/contracts/ci-review-context-request.md`), the assistant-message parser, and the `read_files` handler with realpath-canonicalized repo-root jail. Wire one round-trip of the loop: dispatcher sends a completion, parses any request blocks from the assistant-role message only, executes the request, appends results as a new user message, dispatches a follow-up completion, parses final findings. **Why**: Foundation for SC1 + SC2 (read_files portion). Establishes the contract document and the security boundary that all later stories build on. **Scope**: - IN: contract document with examples and version field; parser scanning assistant-role messages exclusively (refuses to re-parse user/diff content); read_files handler with realpath canonicalization defending against symlink escape; per-file size cap (default 256 KB) + truncation marker with model instruction; single-turn round-trip in dispatch.py; precedence rule when assistant emits both well-formed request and final-findings (request takes precedence) - OUT: grep handler (separate story); multi-turn loop with soft-cap (separate story); caching (separate story); applying loop to all tier reviewers (separate story) ## Done Definitions - When complete, a fixture review can issue one read_files request, receive results, and emit final findings with file:line citations resolved through the round-trip ← Satisfies: SC1 - When complete, the parser refuses to interpret structured-request syntax appearing in user-role messages or diff content as an executable request ← Satisfies: SC1 (injection defense) - When complete, read_files canonicalizes paths via realpath and rejects any path resolving outside the repo root, including via committed or runtime-created symlinks ← Satisfies: SC2 (jail) - When complete, unit tests written and passing for parser (well-formed + malformed + injection vectors), read_files handler (jail bypass attempts including symlinks, size-cap rejection, truncation marker emission), and single-turn round-trip ← Satisfies: SC6 (unit tests for foundation portion) ## Considerations - [Security] Symlink escape is the highest-severity concern — realpath + post-resolve verification mandatory - [Reliability] Parser must fence-strictly to avoid Cline #3992 failure mode (literal-text request emission) - [Maintainability] Contract version field enables future schema evolution ## Escalation Policy **Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an engineer, the structured-request contract, parser, and read_files handler enable a single-turn context-augmentation cycle
